name: 10JNEX900
variant: JFE Super Core JNEX, 6.5 % Si, as-sheared

provenance.source: JFE Technical Report No. 21 (Mar. 2016) p. 46, Fig. 1 'Direct current magnetization curve', dashed 10JNEX900 curve, pixel-traced with tools/digitise_bh.py from docs/sources/materials/jfe_technical_report_21_p46_jnsf.pdf; 32 points log-spaced from 8 A/m to 20 kA/m (the traced curve above 20 kA/m is flatter than mu0 and is left to the saturation tail). Reads 2 % below the JFE catalogue table (B8 1.261 vs 1.29 T, B25 1.375 vs 1.40 T; f1e-002 p. 4); the 50 Hz catalogue curve (f2e-001 p. 9, 0.5-1.4 T) agrees to 0.0007 T on average.

stacking_factor_source: JFE catalogue f1e-002, product dimensions table: space factor 90 % or more (guaranteed minimum used)
saturation_polarisation_source: JFE catalogue f1e-002 p. 4, sample characteristics table, saturation magnetization 1.80 T
density_source: JFE catalogue f1e-002, product dimensions table, 7.49 g/cm3
